props.name: labels
props.description: Names each point — a date, a batch number. Defaults to its position.

props.name: rules
props.description: Which rules to test. Defaults to all five.

props.name: phases
props.description: Indexes where a new phase begins, e.g. after a process change. Limits are recalculated from each one.

props.name: showMovingRange
props.description: Draw the moving-range chart under the individuals chart.

props.name: formatY
props.description: Format values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: onViolationsChange
props.description: Called when the set of violations changes.
